mission: Present runtime state and requests without issuing authority or directly writing stores.
runtimeTopology: RuntimeClient authenticates one backend session/protocol generation, consumes coherent snapshots and submits bounded operation/stop requests. It remains a presentation owner only.
physicalState: Connection, snapshot, pending request and accessibility state are ephemeral. Backend domain facts and terminal outcomes remain authoritative; no UI database or capability issuer is created.
linearization: Snapshot revisions advance monotonically. A request linearizes at an authenticated backend acknowledgement with matching operation and semantic digest, not at a local click.
recovery: Reconnect reconciles stable request identities. Disconnect never proves cancellation. Stale views and incompatible protocol generations disable mutation.
security: Session authentication, stale-view binding and exact operation identity are enforced. Deployment must add CSP, CSRF, origin and browser-session controls without widening authority.
capacity: Pending operations <=1024, view <=1 MiB by profile, retained events <=1000. Render and reconnect work are bounded.
terminalObserver: Only the backend/effect owner can authenticate terminal state. The UI may display pending, indeterminate, failed or terminal observations but cannot manufacture them.
externalEvidenceGaps: selected Web framework/build artifact, deployed authenticated transport, CSP/CSRF and browser support matrix
target accessibility, screen-reader, keyboard, reconnect and backend E2E qualification
